glosses: country, state (politically constituted legal person wielding absolute power of a population and territory)
state/government, authorities (the entire political and administrative system of such an entity)

examples.text: Wir leben in den Vereinigten Staaten.
examples.en: We live in the United States.

examples.text: Ich bin niemals in den Staaten gewesen.
examples.en: I have never been to the States.

examples.text: Er kommt aus den Vereinigten Staaten.
examples.en: He is from the United States.

examples.text: Möchtest du in die Vereinigten Staaten reisen?
examples.en: Would you like to travel to the United States?
